Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit story illustration by recomposing the final reference. The first references are canonical identity portraits for exactly the named humans; preserve their actual face shape, eye spacing, nose, jaw, complexion, age, hairline and equipment. Keep clear bold cel shading, restrained charcoal/navy, muted sage green #6BAA8A interfaces and aged brass #A89060, naturally lit warm skin. No neon green cast, orange wash, plants or photorealistic rendering. Maintain adult stylized head-to-body balance, ordinary neck length and shoulder width. Every human has exactly two complete shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains; five digits per hand with correct thumb side, natural grips, neutral wrists, plausible furniture contact. Any pen must be one continuous straight object. Make a candid story moment with expressive faces and task-directed gazes, never a viewer-facing mugshot. Use available space for the primary lesson display, with large high-contrast words and generous margins. All text, boxes and lines share the actual perspective of their physical screen, which faces its operator and remains readable to the viewer. Avoid labels squeezed into thin strips or little screens beneath blank walls. Other screens may be dark. All required facts are below; no invented measurements, code or filler graphics.
